screensaver.name: gluqlo
screensaver._description: Gluqlo L-Space is a Fliqlo-style flip clock set in a living night landscape with seasons, weather and hundreds of scenery events. It is a fork of Gluqlo by Alexander Kovalenko (2014), which is based on Now Open Flipqlo 2.0 (https://github.com/bhm/noflipqlo) by Jacek Kuzniarski aka bhm. L-Space scenery by tire-regroover; 2026.
